children: Brett H. Pojunis, CEO of GPO Plus, Inc., disclosed beneficial ownership of 12.69% of the company’s common stock. He received new Series A-1 Preferred shares on Sept. 1, 2026, as payment for services and credit support, and filed a Schedule 13D on Sept. 11, 2026. The preferred shares carry 400 million votes, giving him about 75.5% of known voting power and effective control.

Pojunis acquired 4,000,000 shares of Series A-1 Preferred as compensation for his work and for backing the company’s obligations, including personal guarantees and deferred pay. He wrote that the shares were issued as “consideration for services rendered and to be rendered and credit support provided.”

He said the deal did not change control because he already directed the company. In his words, he “already possessed sole voting and management control of the Issuer,” and the new preferred shares simply formalize and extend that control.

Brett H. Pojunis is an American executive and investor who serves as the Chief Executive Officer and sole director of GPO Plus, Inc. He focuses on building the company’s distribution operations and has supported the business with personal guarantees, credit extensions, and deferred compensation. Pojunis’s approach centers on hands-on control and long-term company stewardship.
